summary: Unity developer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in game systems, VR and commercial SDKs. I build full-cycle projects: design architecture, write gameplay and networking code, create tools and payment integrations, and set up builds and CI/CD. Worked on a VR simulator for an industry customer, a VR quest registered in the software registry, and a payment SDK for games. Additional experience in database design and server infrastructure administration. Looking for game development and XR opportunities.

bullets: Developed RuStore Pay and VK Pay integrations for the multiplatform monetization SDK (MultiplatformSDK Kit)
Unified payment providers behind a single purchases API across platforms
Tested payment flows on Android/RuStore and WebGL and wrote test scenarios

work.company: IrGUPS · R&D for a transport company
bullets: Developed a locomotive crew VR simulator as part of an R&D project for an industry customer
Built 3D models of the cab, engine room and body, plus a scene of a real track section
Implemented 9 training modules: troubleshooting, train inspection and securing, locomotive acceptance and handover, cab change, instructor module, testing and exam
Built cooperative multiplayer with a locomotive crew communication protocol
Developed VR occupational safety and first aid simulators with action-order validation, and the VR quest 'Demons of Youth' (tasks, checkpoints, inventory, puzzles)
Delivered cross-platform XR (Meta/Oculus, Pico, SteamVR) and builds for Windows, Android and WebGL
Developed a custom DI framework, SurvDI, used across several projects
Built the SurvMineModTool mod editor on .NET/Avalonia with shared contracts for Unity
Maintained the SurvMine multiplayer voxel sandbox with a modding platform and custom UPM packages
Built game prototypes across genres and backend services: a VK payment server on ASP.NET Core, Telegram bots, homelab infrastructure
